title: Web Security
tagline: Understand, design, test, and operate secure web systems
summary: A broad, defense-oriented textbook covering browser security, identity, authorization, common vulnerability classes, APIs, data protection, infrastructure, supply chains, secure development, testing, monitoring, and incident response. Each lesson connects the threat model to the failure mechanism, practical defenses, trade-offs, and verification.
topics: Security principles, threat modeling, assets, and trust boundaries
HTTP, origins, cookies, CORS, CSP, TLS, and browser isolation
Authentication, sessions, MFA, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect
Authorization, tenant isolation, BOLA, and business-logic abuse
Injection, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, traversal, uploads, and parser differentials
API, GraphQL, webhook, WebSocket, and service-to-service security
Cryptographic hygiene, secrets, databases, privacy, and audit trails
Cloud, containers, configuration, dependencies, and build integrity
Security testing, vulnerability management, monitoring, and incident response
Architecture review and secure document-sharing capstone
